scope: Read-only inspection and hashing of applied graph constructor, controls read snapshot/API, recovery target ancestor guard, actual captured focused/static evidence. No workload run by reviewer.

production_files.equality: AST identical; formatter comparison reflow only

boundaries.conclusion: Canonical Git root and common directory always validated. Default source reuses canonical root; explicit source normalized; distinct roots compare common directories. Existing layout/storage guards and refresh logic unchanged. No new graph cache.

New control_state uses one existing injected unit_of_work, requires run existence, performs run-scoped policy/list reads and no explicit commit. All prior authorization/approval mutation and validators byte unchanged.
Only controls response read switches to the new service snapshot; authentication and approval mutations unchanged.

Capsule normalized/anchored once before full target/ancestor link guard, strict root resolve, target resolve and containment. Recovery ordering, commit/durability and independent atomic-write link check unchanged.

evidence_interpretation: Historical 123-test capture retains original test bytes; fresh 37-test full-file capture covers the two corrected files, exact inverse-import-only hash proof bridges the correction. This is not a single current 123-case run and not 160 unique cases.
new_behavior_case_coverage: Eleven cases captured in v2: canonical graph identity default/same/nested; injected controls factory with/without stored policy and missing run/no mutation; relative capsule anchored before cwd change; missing capsule root; metadata fault; real root and target-parent directory link denial. Recovery cases retained and freshly run in corrected v3 file.

static_evidence.scope: Four checks only, not all eleven release preflight gates

limitations: Custom ApprovalService subclasses overriding only policy/list must also override control_state to customize the API response. Existing UOW factory injection is preserved; arbitrary old method override dispatch is not. No in-repository affected override or concrete P1 found.
Injected stateful Git services can observe fewer redundant constructor calls and changed error ordering; stable LocalGitService and existing repository identity denials remain correct.

Filesystem link checks retain existing TOCTOU limits; neither old nor new helper is race-free. Rare concurrent mutation/error timing is not identical, and helper does not establish that every existing ancestor is a directory.

No browser deadline, latency improvement, full 86-contract closure, full preflight, installed artifact closure, complete qualification rounds or release certification claimed. Previous raw failures remain historical and require fresh original acceptance workloads.
